lines: Fascinating. Two species, same habitat, completely different behaviour. And nobody has measured either.
Two Kunemon, two Tapirmon, if you do not mind. I will take it from there.
I would catch them myself, but they notice my clipboard.
doneLines: Excellent! Notice the difference in the shell texture? No? Neither do I, but the clipboard does.
Your payment, and a promise to thank you in the footnote. Everyone gets a footnote.
remindLines: Two Kunemon and two Tapirmon. The clipboard is empty and sad.
They notice the clipboard. Do not ask me how.

quests.title: Signal strength
quests.text: A Researcher is measuring the signal along the forest edge. Visit the Wire Forest entrance and the west forest and tell him what you notice.

offer.name: Researcher
lines: The signal gets strange at the edge of the Wire Forest. I need someone to walk it and tell me what they notice.
Not numbers. Feelings. Does the air feel different? Do your teeth buzz? These are scientific questions.
Start at the entrance and walk to the west forest. Report back.
doneLines: Teeth buzzing, and a faint hum, and a feeling of being watched by a tree? Marvellous. Data!
A little reward, and a promise to credit you. Under Feelings.
remindLines: Wire Forest entrance, then the west forest. Does anything hum? Do your teeth buzz?
I am writing a section called Feelings. It is very short.

quests.text: A Researcher wants a Revive Disk for his emergency kit before going deeper into the forest.

offer.name: Researcher
lines: I am going deeper into the forest next week, and a good researcher always carries an emergency kit.
I have everything but a Revive Disk. Could you spare one? I will make it worth it.
doneLines: Perfect. The kit is complete. The forest will never see me coming.
Here is a bit of money. And I will name a very small beetle after you.
remindLines: One Revive Disk for the kit. Without it, I am not going anywhere.
I will make a very good notebook entry about you.

quests.text: The Researcher wants to know what a Kunemon sees. Learn the Kunemon form and tell him.

offer.name: Researcher
lines: I want to see a Kunemon from the inside. Not literally. Through the partner's eyes, when it takes the form.
They say a partner can learn the Kunemon form after enough victories. Do it, and tell me what the world looks like.
I will write every word down. I have a new pencil.
doneLines: Everything is slightly sideways? And much louder? Incredible. Absolutely incredible.
Take this. And thank your partner for me. I would shake its hand if it had one.
remindLines: The Kunemon form, and what the world looks like from there. New pencil, ready.
Keep winning. It arrives when you are not looking.

quests.title: The goat story
quests.text: The Traveler keeps promising a story about a goat. He will tell it if you walk Shell Beach and Plug Cape and bring him a detail from each.

objectives.label: Visit Shell Beach and Plug Cape

offer.name: Traveler
lines: About that goat. I owe you a story. The trouble is I have forgotten the middle, and the end.
It happened somewhere on a coast. If you go to Shell Beach and Plug Cape, one of them might remind me. Bring me a detail from each.
A smell. A sound. Whatever you remember. Then I will tell it properly.
doneLines: A bell! A BELL! Of course. The goat rang it to scare the tide. Now I remember the whole thing.
Here is a little something for the story. The goat sends its regards, if goats could.
remindLines: Shell Beach and Plug Cape. A smell, a sound, any detail. The goat is waiting.
It had a bell. I am almost sure it had a bell.

quests.text: The Traveler has a postcard and no address. He asks you to carry it to the Old Woman in Central Park, since she knows everyone.

objectives.name: Old Woman
lines: A postcard? For nobody? Let me see. Ah, I know that handwriting. That is the Traveler's. He sends them to everyone and nobody.

lines: I have a postcard and no address. I wrote it in a very good mood and forgot who it was for.
The Old Woman in Central Park knows everyone. Would you take it to her and ask who it belongs to?
I would go, but this forest gate is surprisingly comfortable.
doneLines: She knew. Of course she knew. She said it was for her, which is strange, because I have never met her. Or have I.
Here. Thank you for the mystery. It was worth the walk.
remindLines: One postcard, for the Old Woman. She will know whose it is.
It is a very good postcard. It has a picture of a goat.

quests.title: Waiting for a bite
quests.text: The Fisherman says the fish are scared of the Gizamon. Beat four Gizamon at Shell Beach so the water goes quiet.

offer.name: Fisherman
lines: The water is not the problem. The fish are not the problem. The Gizamon are the problem.
Four of them, thrashing about, and every fish within a mile is hiding. Quieter water, better bite.
I do not mind waiting. But I would like to wait with a bite.
doneLines: The water is quiet. A fish nibbled just now. It was polite about it.
Take this. The sea gave it to me, and I am giving it to you. That is how the sea works.
remindLines: Four Gizamon at Shell Beach. The fish are watching from the deep.
I am in no hurry. But the tide is.

quests.title: The big one
quests.text: The Fisherman swears there is a Shellmon big as a boat off Plug Cape. Defeat one.

offer.name: Fisherman
lines: There is a shell off Plug Cape the size of a rowboat. Everyone tells me it is a rock. It moves.
A Shellmon. Maybe the oldest one. It has been listening to the sea since before the pier. I would like to know it is not angry.
Fight it, if you must. Gently, if you can. And tell me what it said.
doneLines: So it was a Shellmon, and it was only sleepy. That explains the tide.
Here is your pay, and my thanks. The sea sends hers too.
remindLines: The big shell off Plug Cape. It moves. It listens. It has opinions.
Be gentle with it. It is older than the pier.

quests.title: A ship, maybe
quests.text: The Lookout Boy thinks he saw a ship on the horizon. Visit Shell Beach and the Wire Forest entrance and see whether anyone else saw it too.

objectives.label: Visit Shell Beach and the Wire Forest entrance

offer.name: Lookout Boy
lines: Report! I saw a ship on the horizon. A real one. White sails. I think.
Nobody believes me. The cape is too windy to hear properly. Could you go to Shell Beach and the forest gate and ask around?
If someone else saw it, I will stop being sure I was dreaming.
doneLines: Someone saw it! Not sails, a very big cloud shaped like sails. But it counts!
Here. A lookout always pays his scouts. It is in the manual. I am writing the manual.
remindLines: Shell Beach and the forest gate. Did anyone see white sails? Report back.
I am watching the horizon. Do not worry. I never blink.

quests.title: Something large in the surf
quests.text: The Lookout Boy keeps reporting a large grey shape near Plug Cape. Beat a Coelamon and a Tuskmon and see if the shape is gone.

offer.name: Lookout Boy
lines: Report! A large grey shape in the surf. It moves slowly. It blows water. I think it is thinking about me.
A couple of Coelamon and a Tuskmon have been hanging around. I think one of them is the shape.
I cannot fight. I can only report. Please. For the cape.
doneLines: The shape is gone! Or it is hiding. Either way, I am safe. Mostly.
A reward, from the lookout fund. It is mostly pebbles, but some of it is real.
remindLines: Two Coelamon and a Tuskmon around Plug Cape. The shape is watching me.
I will keep reporting. That is my job. It is a good job.
